title: Garou Densetsu 3: Road to the Final Victory
native_title: 餓狼伝説３ ～遥かなる闘い～
overview:
Will the legend rise again across 2,000 years!?

A "distant battle" waged by hungry wolves over the "Secret Scrolls of Qin" from before the Common Era. The head-to-head fighting action that was a huge hit in arcades in '95 is finally here!!

- A high-quality port that rivals the arcade!
- The system and the wide variety of special moves are faithfully reproduced!
- The ending changes depending on various conditions!

Survive the endless fights to the death and unravel the mystery of the secret scrolls!

伝説は2千年の時を超えて蘇るか!?

紀元前の「秦の秘伝書」をめぐって餓狼たちが繰り広げる“遥かなる闘い”。'95年、アーケードで大人気を呼んだ対戦格闘アクションがついに登場!!

●アーケードに匹敵する完成度の高い移植!
●システムや多彩な必殺技なども忠実再現!
●様々な条件によってエンディングが変化!

果てしない死闘を勝ち抜いて、秘伝書の謎を解き明かせ!
